# WebMind project instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before editing or reviewing this repository. Start with [docs/README.md](../docs/README.md), [current status](../docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md), and [development workflow](../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md), then the task-specific documents.

Preserve unsaved user drafts, account isolation, and Drive originals. Follow the shared rules instead of duplicating them here. Update relevant documentation with code changes and run `npm run docs:check`. During review, flag behavior changes that lack matching documentation and distinguish mock checks from real Google/production evidence.
